authority: The trailing "e" is not an exponent-separator-sign: F&O 4.7.3 requires one to be "both preceded and followed within the sub-picture by an active character", and nothing follows it. XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: "The suffix is set to contain all passive characters to the right of the rightmost active character in the sub-picture". The value rounds to zero at maximum-fractional-part-size 1, which 4.7.5 writes as a decimal-separator on its own, padded to minimum-integer-part-size 1 and then stripped of the separator.
